# Genuine B0 schema-3 information fixture

[Español](README.es.md). `B0-schema3.dat` was produced before B1 source changes
using `445217e4503f9077c6dd53aef7c6cf9f53cf5b24`, the canonical project
interpreter, a sandbox start and official save API. It contains the actual old
WorldState/NodePoolState slot layout, not an emulation with fields removed.

ECHO_7's existing pool has consumed uplink and mounted base files; another real
procedural waystation remains uninitialized. `B0-schema3.json` records the seed,
pool fields, mounted content, target ID and exact SHA-256. The fixture is
instrumental and does not claim to be a public playthrough. Tests verify new
slot defaults, intact old data and continued legacy production for that target.
